heroes.name: Hale
heroes.title: The Relentless Hunter
heroes.lore: Hale hunted war profiteers through territories others considered too ruined to cross. He believes a destructive choice must be pursued until its consequences can no longer escape.

basicAttack.name: Field Sign
basicAttack.description: Deals 120% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP and applies Quarry for 2 rounds. Quarry reveals the target’s current HP and makes Hale’s attacks against it ignore 10% Defense.

activeSkill.name: Closing Radius
activeSkill.description: Deals 220% of Attack damage to the enemy with Quarry. If any ally attacked it since Hale’s last turn, deals additional damage equal to 12% of its missing HP, up to 120% of Attack.

passive1.name: Tracking Habit
passive1.description: Hale gains 10% Attack and 10% Critical Chance. At the end of a round in which Quarry was not defeated, move Quarry to the enemy that dealt the most damage that round.

passive2.name: No Safe Distance
passive2.description: When a Quarry target gains a Shield or becomes Untargetable, Hale immediately deals 70% of Attack damage to it and removes Quarry. This triggers once per target each battle.

talentI.name: Fresh Trail
talentI.description: The first attack against a new Quarry target has 20% additional Critical Damage.

talentII.name: Cornered
talentII.description: Closing Radius deals its missing-HP damage even if no ally attacked Quarry when Hale is below 50% HP.

talentIII.name: Pursuit Continues
talentIII.description: When a Quarry target is defeated, Hale immediately applies Quarry to the lowest-HP remaining enemy for 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Kael
heroes.title: The Unyielding
heroes.lore: Kael opened the gates of a doomed fortress and dismantled its defenses before the invader could claim them. He believes protection that has failed must be broken deliberately, then made useful to those still standing.

basicAttack.name: Breach Inspection
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% of Attack damage to the front enemy and applies Fault Line for 2 rounds. Fault Line makes the next Shield, DefenseUp, or Damage Reduction effect the target gains Fragile.

activeSkill.name: Take Down the Wall
activeSkill.description: Deals 210% of Attack damage to all enemies. Remove one Fragile defensive effect from each enemy, then gain one Rubble for each effect removed, up to 4. Rubble is retained for 3 rounds.

passive1.name: Unusable Cover
passive1.description: Kael gains 12% Defense and 8% Block. At the end of an ally turn, if that ally has a Shield while Kael holds Rubble, consume 1 Rubble to move 30% of that Shield to the ally with the lowest HP. This can trigger once per round.

passive2.name: What Breaks Forward
passive2.description: When Kael uses a Basic Attack while holding Rubble, consume all Rubble. The attack deals an additional 35% of Attack damage per Rubble to the target, then the lowest-HP ally gains a Shield equal to 4% of Kael’s Max HP per Rubble.

talentI.name: Measured Demolition
talentI.description: Fault Line also reduces the target’s Effect Resist by 10% while it has a Fragile defensive effect.

talentII.name: Clear the Debris
talentII.description: Take Down the Wall applies Fault Line for 2 rounds to enemies from whom it removed a defensive effect.

talentIII.name: Lasting Materials
talentIII.description: Rubble no longer expires after 3 rounds. Kael can hold up to 5 Rubble, but Take Down the Wall deals 10% less base damage.

heroes.name: Kiva
heroes.title: The Forsaken Oath
heroes.lore: Kiva severed the supply lines of a war she could not end by force. She believes an enemy becomes vulnerable when the support they count on is made unreliable.

basicAttack.name: Cut the Escort
basicAttack.description: Deals 125% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP and applies Forsaken for 2 rounds.

activeSkill.name: Sever the Return
activeSkill.description: Deals 245% of Attack damage to a Forsaken enemy. If it gained a Shield or was healed since Kiva’s last turn, remove one such effect and deal additional damage equal to 10% of its missing HP, up to 130% of Attack.

passive1.name: Abandoned Support
passive1.description: Kiva gains 10% Attack, 10% Speed, and 8% Crit Chance. The first time each round a Forsaken target gains a positive effect, Kiva stores its name as a Broken Link. Kiva can hold up to 2 Broken Links.

passive2.name: Severance Paid
passive2.description: When Kiva attacks a Forsaken target while holding Broken Links, consume one Broken Link to prevent that target from receiving healing until the end of its next turn. If it already cannot be healed, instead remove 15 Energy. Each target can be affected once per round.

talentI.name: No Safe Escort
talentI.description: Forsaken also prevents the target from gaining Block for its duration.

talentII.name: Cut the Last Line
talentII.description: Cut the Escort applies Forsaken to the enemy with the highest HP if its primary target is defeated.

talentIII.name: Unclaimed Victory
talentIII.description: When an enemy is defeated, Kiva gains a Shield equal to 16% of her Max HP for 3 rounds. If she is holding a Broken Link, she gains a further 12% of her Max HP and all Broken Links are consumed.

heroes.name: Marrow
heroes.title: The Irrevocable Vow
heroes.lore: Marrow promised to remain with a collapsing relief column until every survivor had crossed the pass. He believes that a choice earns its meaning only when it costs something to uphold.

basicAttack.name: Witnessed Strike
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% of Attack damage to the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally for 55% of Attack. If that ally took damage since Marrow’s last turn, store 30% of the healing as Promise.

activeSkill.name: Vow Kept
activeSkill.description: Deals 175% of Attack damage to all enemies and gives the two lowest-HP allies Promise for 2 rounds. At the start of their next turn, Promise heals them for 8% Max HP and removes one debuff.

passive1.name: The Cost Is Named
passive1.description: Marrow gains 10% HP and 10% Effect Resist. When an ally with Promise takes damage, Marrow takes 20% of it instead and increases that ally’s next Promise heal by the absorbed amount, up to 10% Max HP.

passive2.name: Promise Survives
passive2.description: The first time an ally with Promise would be defeated, consume Promise and leave them at 1 HP. Marrow then becomes unable to receive healing for 1 round. This triggers once per battle.

talentI.name: Shared Oath
talentI.description: Promise can be given to three allies instead of two, but its delayed heal is reduced to 6% Max HP.

talentII.name: Visible Cost
talentII.description: When Marrow redirects damage through The Cost Is Named, the attacker loses 5 Energy.

talentIII.name: No Withdrawal
talentIII.description: After Promise Survives triggers, Marrow immediately uses Witnessed Strike against the lowest-HP enemy.

heroes.name: Seraphine
heroes.title: The Closed Volume
heroes.lore: Seraphine preserved the records of failed states until she concluded that contradictions should be confronted, not preserved out of habit. She embraces Ember because change requires a system to admit where it no longer holds.

basicAttack.name: Marginal Note
basicAttack.description: Deals 115% of Attack damage and applies Footnote for 2 rounds. Footnote records 25% of the first skill damage the target takes each round, up to 80% of Seraphine’s Attack.

activeSkill.name: Contradiction Filed
activeSkill.description: Deals 205% of Attack damage to all enemies. Each enemy with Footnote takes additional damage equal to its recorded Footnote amount, then Footnote moves to the enemy with the highest Energy for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Contrary Evidence
passive1.description: Seraphine gains 8% Attack, 10% Effect Hit, and 10% Skill Damage. When an enemy with Footnote gains a buff, remove one of its other buffs and increase its Footnote record by 20% of Seraphine’s Attack.

passive2.name: Volume Closed
passive2.description: When a Footnote record reaches its cap, the target becomes Unable to Gain Buffs for 1 round. When that restriction ends, Footnote is removed and Seraphine gains 15 Energy.

talentI.name: Second Reading
talentI.description: Footnote records 35% instead of 25% of the first skill damage taken each round.

talentII.name: Cross Reference
talentII.description: Contradiction Filed gives the Footnote moved to the highest-Energy enemy an immediate record equal to 30% of Seraphine’s Attack.

talentIII.name: No Revision
talentIII.description: An enemy made Unable to Gain Buffs by Volume Closed also loses 10% turn progress.

heroes.name: Branik
heroes.title: The Siege Mason
heroes.lore: A mason who tore down a tyrant’s walls, Branik believes destruction can make room for a safer life.

basicAttack.name: Faultline Tap
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Cracked for 2 rounds. Cracked reduces Block by 12%.

activeSkill.name: Demolition Right
activeSkill.description: Deals 180% Attack damage to the front enemy. If it is Cracked, removes Cracked and grants Branik a Shield equal to 16% Max HP for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Salvaged Cover
passive1.description: The first time each round a Cracked enemy attacks, Branik gains 8% Damage Reduction until round end.

heroes.name: Demos
heroes.title: The Debt Collector
heroes.lore: A magistrate who watched gentle penalties preserve cruelty, Demos believes consequences must intensify until someone changes.

basicAttack.name: Notice of Loss
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Arrears for 2 rounds. At turn end, Arrears loses 4% current HP.

activeSkill.name: Compounding Sentence
activeSkill.description: Deals 175% Attack damage to enemies with Arrears and extends Arrears by 1 round, up to 3 rounds.

passive1.name: No Appeal
passive1.description: Enemies with Arrears receive 20% less healing; on defeat, their Arrears moves to the highest-HP enemy.

heroes.name: Kest
heroes.title: The Bridgebreaker
heroes.lore: Kest destroyed the bridge behind a retreating army and stayed to ensure it held. He trusts irreversible choices.

basicAttack.name: Commitment Cut
basicAttack.description: Deals 120% Attack damage. If Kest attacked this target last turn, deals 35% additional Attack damage.

activeSkill.name: No Way Back
activeSkill.description: Deals 260% Attack damage to Kest’s last target. On defeat, attacks the lowest-HP enemy for 100% Attack damage.

passive1.name: Commit to the Return
passive1.description: Kest cannot change targets while his target lives, but deals 12% more damage to it and takes 10% less from it.

heroes.name: Orelle
heroes.title: The Fever Warden
heroes.lore: After sealing an infected hospice to stop a plague, Orelle devoted her life to everyone who escaped.

basicAttack.name: Measured Tap
basicAttack.description: Deals 100% Attack damage and heals the lowest-HP ally for 55% Attack.

activeSkill.name: Hard Remedy
activeSkill.description: Deals 155% Attack damage to all enemies, removes one debuff from each ally, and cleansed allies recover 8% missing HP.

passive1.name: Triage After Loss
passive1.description: The first time an ally falls below 35% HP, grant them a 12% Max HP Shield for 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Tavia
heroes.title: The Signal Huntress
heroes.lore: Tavia exposed a corrupt relay network by severing its signals in public; every broken connection can force a truth into view.

basicAttack.name: Rangefinder Bolt
basicAttack.description: Deals 115% Attack damage to the highest-Attack enemy and applies Exposed Frequency for 2 rounds. Allied attacks ignore 8% Defense against it.

activeSkill.name: Cut the Wire
activeSkill.description: Deals 230% Attack damage to an enemy with Exposed Frequency, then transfers its buffs to the lowest-HP enemy for 1 round.

passive1.name: Dead Channel
passive1.description: When an enemy with Exposed Frequency gains a buff, Tavia deals 45% Attack damage to it once per round.

heroes.name: Adric
heroes.title: The Blank Map
heroes.lore: Adric destroyed the maps that led raiders to his mountain valley. A lost route, he believes, is sometimes a saved life.

basicAttack.name: Mapcase Bash
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Lost Route for 2 rounds. Lost Route reduces Accuracy by 12%.

activeSkill.name: Erase the Road
activeSkill.description: Deals 165% Attack damage to all enemies with Lost Route and grants Adric a Shield equal to 12% Max HP for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: No Return Mark
passive1.description: When an enemy with Lost Route misses, Adric gains 8 Energy.

heroes.name: Aster
heroes.title: The Glassblower
heroes.lore: Aster broke the glass monopoly that kept a city’s poor in darkness. She believes fragile things can reveal where pressure truly lies.

basicAttack.name: Scoring Point
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and applies Fracture for 2 rounds. Fracture causes the next critical hit to deal 15% more damage.

activeSkill.name: Shatterproof
activeSkill.description: Deals 190% Attack damage to an enemy with Fracture and spreads Fracture to adjacent enemies for 1 round.

passive1.name: Stress Line
passive1.description: When an enemy with Fracture is defeated, all remaining enemies lose 6 Energy.

heroes.name: Quin
heroes.title: The Sealed Dispatch
heroes.lore: Quin delivered the final notices that ended a corrupt guild. He thinks change arrives only when someone carries it all the way.

basicAttack.name: Stamped Parcel
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Delivered for 2 rounds. Delivered targets take 8% more damage from the next active skill.

activeSkill.name: Return to Sender
activeSkill.description: Deals 185% Attack damage to all Delivered enemies and removes Delivered to give Quin 12 Energy per target.

passive1.name: Urgent Matter
passive1.description: Quin’s first active skill each battle costs 15 less Energy.

heroes.name: Selka
heroes.title: The Unheard Appeal
heroes.lore: Selka abandoned the courts after watching every appeal protect the powerful. She makes failures impossible to postpone.

basicAttack.name: Filed Objection
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and applies Overdue for 2 rounds. Overdue reduces received healing by 15%.

activeSkill.name: Deadline
activeSkill.description: Deals 210% Attack damage to an Overdue enemy. If it is below 35% HP, deals 60% additional Attack damage.

passive1.name: No Extension
passive1.description: Overdue cannot be cleansed during the round it was applied.

heroes.name: Arno
heroes.title: The Unfinished Mason
heroes.lore: Arno left a monument unfinished after its patron betrayed the workers who built it. He trusts work that refuses to flatter the powerful.

basicAttack.name: Chisel Strike
basicAttack.description: Deals 115% Attack damage. If the target has a Shield, deals 20% additional Attack damage.

passive1.name: Rubble Resolve
passive1.description: When an enemy Shield is removed, Arno gains 8% Attack for 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Barr
heroes.title: The Splintered Door
heroes.lore: Barr tore down his own workshop door so trapped neighbors could escape a collapse. A barrier is only useful until it must break.

basicAttack.name: Splintering Blow
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and grants Barr 8% Damage Reduction for 1 round.

passive1.name: Give Way
passive1.description: When Barr falls below 40% HP, he gains a Shield equal to 10% Max HP once per battle.

heroes.name: Piri
heroes.title: The Match Seller
heroes.lore: Piri sabotaged price boards that kept a district hungry. She knows one small spark can make an unfair order fail.

basicAttack.name: Price Breaker
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and removes 5 Energy from the target.

passive1.name: Cheap Kindling
passive1.description: When Piri defeats an enemy, she gains 15 Energy.

heroes.name: Fenn
heroes.title: The Parcel Runner
heroes.lore: Fenn carried supplies through a workers’ blockade, convinced that pressure only changes things when it reaches the right place.

basicAttack.name: Cargo Spark
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP.

heroes.name: Ulric
heroes.title: The Fallen Sign
heroes.lore: Ulric pulled down a warning sign that had become an excuse to abandon a neighborhood. He believes old protections must sometimes be broken.

basicAttack.name: Signpost Strike
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage to the front enemy.

heroes.name: Nereia
heroes.title: The Field Medic
heroes.lore: Nereia was a field medic who never treated two wounded soldiers the same way. She studied every battlefield as a shifting pattern, moving strength from where it was wasted to where it was needed. She came to believe that survival was not about resisting every change, but knowing what could be moved before the next crisis arrived.

basicAttack.name: Shared Pain
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% of Attack damage to the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally for 45% of Attack. If another ally has more than 80% HP, transfer 5% of that ally's reserve HP to the healed ally before the healing is applied.

activeSkill.name: Relief Circuit
activeSkill.description: Deals 170% of Attack damage to all enemies and heals the two lowest-HP allies for 100% of Attack. For 2 rounds, 20% of damage received by each healed ally is redirected to Nereia. Nereia stores 50% of the redirected damage as Reserve, up to 20% of her Max HP. When the effect ends, consume Reserve to heal the lowest-HP ally for the stored amount.

passive1.name: Triage Buffer
passive1.description: Nereia gains 10% Max HP and 10% Effect Resist. Whenever Nereia receives redirected damage or heals an ally below 40% HP, she gains 1 Flow, up to 4. At 4 Flow, her next Basic Attack also heals the lowest-HP ally for 70% of Attack and consumes all Flow.

passive2.name: Change of Course
passive2.description: Whenever an ally under Relief Circuit would receive lethal damage, redirect the remaining damage to Nereia instead and immediately heal that ally for 12% of their Max HP. This can trigger once per round. If Nereia has Reserve stored, consume up to 50% of the stored Reserve to reduce the redirected damage by the consumed amount.

talentI.name: Deeper Reservoir
talentI.description: Nereia's maximum Reserve increases by 5% of her Max HP. When Reserve is consumed for healing, restore 10 Energy.

talentII.name: Shared Reserve
talentII.description: When Relief Circuit ends, 50% of its stored Reserve is also converted into a Shield for the lowest-HP ally lasting 2 rounds.

talentIII.name: Reversed Flow
talentIII.description: When Change of Course triggers, Nereia deals damage equal to 80% of the redirected damage to the enemy with the highest Attack. This damage cannot exceed 15% of Nereia's Max HP.

heroes.name: Rheia
heroes.title: The Revision Scribe
heroes.lore: Rheia was a historian who discovered that the same catastrophe had been recorded differently by every survivor. Rather than deciding which account was true, she learned to find the moment when one version could become another. She came to believe that nothing is truly fixed; every outcome contains a direction that can still be changed.

basicAttack.name: Revision Script
basicAttack.description: Deals 115% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack. If that enemy has AttackUp, remove the status and apply DefenseDown for 2 rounds.

activeSkill.name: Rewrite the Outcome
activeSkill.description: Deals 200% of Attack damage to all enemies and applies DefenseDown for 2 rounds. If an enemy has AttackDown, remove it and apply AttackUp to that enemy for 2 rounds, then deal an additional 45% of Attack damage to that enemy. For each enemy whose status is changed by this skill, Rheia gains 5 Energy, up to 20 Energy.

passive1.name: Applied Revision
passive1.description: Rheia gains 8% Attack, 10% Effect Hit, and 8% Skill Damage. Whenever an enemy gains or loses a status from Rheia's abilities, Rheia gains 1 Revision, up to 4. Each Revision increases her Speed by 3%.

passive2.name: Second Draft
passive2.description: When an enemy affected by DefenseDown gains AttackUp or an enemy affected by AttackDown gains DefenseDown, Rheia deals 70% of Attack damage to that enemy and gains 10 Energy. This can trigger once per enemy each round. At 4 Revision, the next trigger consumes all Revision and deals an additional 100% of Attack damage.

talentI.name: Endless Revision
talentI.description: When Rewrite the Outcome changes a status, Rheia gains 3 Energy instead of 5. Each affected enemy also receives an additional 20% of Attack damage.

talentII.name: Counterrevision
talentII.description: When Second Draft triggers, Rheia also applies AttackDown to the target for 2 rounds if the target has AttackUp, or DefenseUp if the target has DefenseDown.

talentIII.name: Perfect Reversal
talentIII.description: At 4 Revision, Second Draft no longer consumes Revision. Instead, the next time it triggers, its additional damage is increased by 80% of Attack and Rheia loses 10 Energy.

heroes.name: Rovan
heroes.title: The Adaptive Commander
heroes.lore: Rovan survived a retreat by moving a shield from hand to hand rather than holding the line alone. He believes defense should be redirected to wherever the next blow will land.

basicAttack.name: Deflection Strike
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% of Attack damage to the front enemy and applies Deflected for 2 rounds. The first time that enemy damages an ally each round, Rovan gains a Shield equal to 20% of the damage dealt.

activeSkill.name: Pass the Guard
activeSkill.description: Deals 185% of Attack damage to all enemies. Move all Shields on Rovan to the lowest-HP ally and apply Covered to that ally for 2 rounds. While Covered, 25% of damage they take is redirected to Rovan before Shields are checked.

passive1.name: Adaptive Guard
passive1.description: Rovan gains 10% Max HP, 8% Defense, and 8% Block. When Rovan receives redirected damage from Covered, remove one debuff from that ally and apply it to Rovan for its remaining duration. This can trigger once per round.

passive2.name: Return the Guard
passive2.description: When Covered expires or its bearer is defeated, move that ally’s remaining Shield to Rovan. If the Shield moved is at least 10% of the ally’s Max HP, Rovan immediately deals 75% of Attack damage to all Deflected enemies.

talentI.name: Shared Angle
talentI.description: Covered also grants its bearer 10% Effect Resist for 2 rounds.

talentII.name: No Wasted Guard
talentII.description: When Pass the Guard moves a Shield, the recipient gains 8 Energy for every 10% Max HP Shield moved, up to 16 Energy.

talentIII.name: Guard in Motion
talentIII.description: When Covered expires naturally, Rovan also grants the ally with the next-lowest HP a Shield equal to 8% of his Max HP for 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Talren
heroes.title: The Wayfinder
heroes.lore: Talren mapped battlefields rather than roads. He became famous for turning failed ambushes into victories by abandoning the planned route and finding another before his enemies could react. He came to believe that no position is permanent, and that survival belongs to those who can always find another path.

basicAttack.name: Redirecting Shot
basicAttack.description: Deals 120% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack. If another enemy has lower HP than the target, 40% of the damage dealt is repeated against that enemy.

activeSkill.name: Change the Course
activeSkill.description: Deals 220% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack and 130% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP. Talren records both targets for 2 rounds. The next time either recorded target is attacked by Talren, the attack also strikes the other recorded target for 70% of Attack damage.

passive1.name: Adaptive Path
passive1.description: Talren gains 8% Attack, 8% Speed, and 8% Crit Chance. Whenever an attack causes Talren to damage a different target than his previous attack, he gains 1 Route, up to 3. Each Route increases his Crit Damage by 6%.

passive2.name: Where the Arrow Lands
passive2.description: Whenever Talren's attack triggers against a secondary target through Redirecting Shot or Change the Course, he gains 8 Energy and heals for 35% of Attack. If the secondary target is below 30% HP, the damage against it is increased by 50% of Attack.

talentI.name: Open Route
talentI.description: At 3 Route, Talren's next attack against a new target deals an additional 70% of Attack damage and consumes all Route.

talentII.name: Dual Record
talentII.description: Change the Course records one additional enemy - the one with the highest HP. When a recorded target is attacked, the additional strike is made against the recorded target with the highest present HP.

talentIII.name: Final Path
talentIII.description: When Change the Course's recorded effect triggers for the second time, consume all Route to deal an additional 35% of Attack damage per Route to both recorded targets.

heroes.name: Vaelis
heroes.title: The Unfixed Blade
heroes.lore: Vaelis learned that a duel is won by making opponents react to the place he just left. He believes every committed position should become an opening for someone else.

basicAttack.name: Leaving Cut
basicAttack.description: Deals 125% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP. If Vaelis attacked a different enemy on his previous turn, apply Departure to that previous enemy for 2 rounds. Departure causes the next allied hit against it to also deal 45% of Attack damage to Vaelis’s current target.

activeSkill.name: Passed Position
activeSkill.description: Deals 220% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack and 150% to the enemy with the lowest HP. Vaelis designates the second target as his current target. If either target has Departure, move all its positive effects to the other target for 1 round.

passive1.name: Never Still
passive1.description: Vaelis gains 10% Speed, 8% Crit Chance, and 8% Crit Damage. When Departure triggers, Vaelis records the triggering ally’s role. His next Basic Attack against a different target gains a bonus: Bulwark/Vanguard grants 10% Armor Break, Mender/Warden heals Vaelis for 50% of Attack, and any damage role grants 35% additional Attack damage.

passive2.name: Opening Moves
passive2.description: When a target with Departure is defeated, apply Departure to the enemy with the highest HP for 2 rounds and advance Vaelis by 15% turn progress. This can trigger once per round.

talentI.name: False Exit
talentI.description: Departure also reduces the target’s Effect Resist by 10% until it triggers.

talentII.name: Stolen Position
talentII.description: Passed Position moves up to two positive effects instead of all positive effects for 1 round.

talentIII.name: No Place to Hold
talentIII.description: When Departure triggers from a Mender or Warden ally, Vaelis immediately gains 12 Energy.

heroes.name: Celen
heroes.title: The Open Hand
heroes.lore: Celen divided the inheritance that made him powerful among those who had maintained it. Nothing valuable should stay in one hand.

basicAttack.name: Offered Strike
basicAttack.description: Deals 100% Attack damage and gives the lowest-Energy ally 10 Energy.

activeSkill.name: Distribution
activeSkill.description: Deals 150% Attack damage to all enemies, then transfers the largest ally Shield to the lowest-HP ally and extends it 1 round.

passive1.name: Nothing Hoarded
passive1.description: At round start, transfer 15 Energy from the highest-Energy ally to the lowest if their difference is at least 30.

heroes.name: Mika
heroes.title: The Salvage Pilot
heroes.lore: Mika rebuilt abandoned war machines from whichever side left them behind; every tool has a better use elsewhere.

basicAttack.name: Reclaimed Round
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Loose Parts for 2 rounds. The next ally to hit it gains 8 Energy.

activeSkill.name: Parts Exchange
activeSkill.description: Deals 185% Attack damage to enemies with Loose Parts, then moves each effect to an unmarked enemy for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Find a Use
passive1.description: When an ally gains Energy from Loose Parts, Mika gains a Shield equal to 10% Attack for 1 round.

heroes.name: Rhys
heroes.title: The Fence Walker
heroes.lore: Once accused by both sides of a feud, Rhys learned that a fixed side is merely a trap with better banners.

basicAttack.name: Crossing Cut
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and swaps HP percentage with the lowest-HP ally if they are below 50%.

activeSkill.name: Change Sides
activeSkill.description: Deals 195% Attack damage and swaps Rhys’s buffs with the target’s debuffs for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Shared Peril
passive1.description: When an ally takes a hit exceeding 25% Max HP, Rhys takes 30% of it instead, once per round.

heroes.name: Siofra
heroes.title: The Turncoat Oracle
heroes.lore: Siofra’s predictions always changed the battle she entered. She trusts a future only after it has been overturned.

basicAttack.name: Bad Omen
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and changes one target buff into its matching debuff for 2 rounds.

activeSkill.name: Forecast Reversed
activeSkill.description: Deals 190% Attack damage to all enemies and reverses one Attack, Defense, or Speed modifier on each.

passive1.name: Prediction Cost
passive1.description: Whenever Siofra changes a buff into a debuff, that target loses 8 Energy once per round.

heroes.name: Vanno
heroes.title: The Detour King
heroes.lore: Vanno smuggled refugees along routes nobody thought worth guarding. A direct path, he says, is the easiest way to be found.

basicAttack.name: Wrong Turn
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and applies Misdirected for 2 rounds. The target’s first gained buff each round goes to a random ally.

activeSkill.name: Road Not Taken
activeSkill.description: Deals 205% Attack damage to a Misdirected enemy and moves its debuffs to the highest-HP enemy for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Exit Unmarked
passive1.description: When a Misdirected enemy dies, Vanno becomes Untargetable until his next turn.

heroes.name: Bren
heroes.title: The Extra Measure
heroes.lore: Bren kept an alternate route marked for every crossing. He believes every journey needs another way forward.

basicAttack.name: Shared Passage
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and gives the lowest-HP ally 8% Damage Reduction for 1 round.

activeSkill.name: Take Another Route
activeSkill.description: Deals 180% Attack damage and swaps the target’s present HP percentage with the highest-HP enemy.

passive1.name: Reserved Passage
passive1.description: When an ally falls below 30% HP, Bren advances their turn by 15%, once per battle.

heroes.name: Cal
heroes.title: The Alternate Angle
heroes.lore: Cal became a surveyor after surviving an ambush because he had looked the wrong way at the right time.

basicAttack.name: Ricochet Mark
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and applies Offset for 2 rounds. The next ally attack on the target also deals 25% damage to an adjacent enemy.

activeSkill.name: Corner Shot
activeSkill.description: Deals 200% Attack damage to an Offset enemy; its splash damage strikes both adjacent enemies.

passive1.name: New Sightline
passive1.description: When Offset splash defeats an enemy, Cal gains a guaranteed Critical Hit on his next attack.

heroes.name: Linnet
heroes.title: The Misdialed
heroes.lore: Linnet learned that a wrongly connected call could save people from the police. She trusts accidents that reroute certainty.

basicAttack.name: Wrong Number
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Crossed Line for 2 rounds. The target’s first debuff each round goes to a random enemy.

activeSkill.name: Operator Error
activeSkill.description: Deals 170% Attack damage to all Crossed Line enemies and delays them by 15% turn progress.

passive1.name: Open Circuit
passive1.description: When Crossed Line redirects a debuff, Linnet gains 10 Energy.

heroes.name: Oswin
heroes.title: The Refit Surgeon
heroes.lore: Oswin rebuilt damaged limbs instead of replacing their owners. He believes what is broken can be directed into another use.

basicAttack.name: Corrective Cut
basicAttack.description: Deals 100% Attack damage and heals the ally with the most debuffs for 50% Attack.

activeSkill.name: Reposition the Hurt
activeSkill.description: Deals 150% Attack damage to all enemies, then moves one debuff from each ally onto the highest-HP enemy for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Useful Scar
passive1.description: Allies who lose a debuff to Oswin gain 8% Defense for 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Dett
heroes.title: The Untied Knot
heroes.lore: Dett cut a tow line to save a ship from a collapsed bridge. Staying attached, he learned, can be the greater danger.

basicAttack.name: Unmoored Swing
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and advances Dett’s next turn by 8%.

passive1.name: Turn With It
passive1.description: When Dett is targeted by an active skill, he gains 8% Damage Reduction for 1 round.

heroes.name: Hod
heroes.title: The Redirected Load
heroes.lore: Hod rerouted cargo lifts during a structural collapse so supplies reached rooftops instead of warehouses. He believes nothing should remain where it started.

basicAttack.name: Cargo Bolt
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and moves 5 Energy from the target to the lowest-Energy ally.

passive1.name: Counterweight
passive1.description: When an ally gains Energy from Hod, they gain 5% Defense for 1 round.

heroes.name: Yara
heroes.title: The Spare Compass
heroes.lore: Yara always carried a second compass because every expedition deserved another answer. A direction is a tool, not a command.

basicAttack.name: Deflection Shot
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and gives the lowest-HP ally 5% Speed for 1 round.

passive1.name: Second Bearing
passive1.description: When Yara attacks a different target than last turn, she gains 10 Energy.

heroes.name: Moss
heroes.title: The Side Route
heroes.lore: Moss survived by following forgotten alleys rather than the royal road. He never mistakes one route for the only route.

basicAttack.name: Side Shot
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage to a random enemy.

heroes.name: Orenna
heroes.title: The Turning Wheel
heroes.lore: Orenna left the family mill when it began to own the village. She believes a wheel must turn or it becomes a wall.

basicAttack.name: Wheelhouse Swing
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and gains 5 Energy.

heroes.name: Brenna
heroes.title: The Remaining Wall
heroes.lore: Brenna held a settlement together after its defenders were gone, remembering every place the wall nearly failed. She believes survival is built from dangers endured and not forgotten.

basicAttack.name: Stubborn Blow
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% of Attack damage to the front enemy and gives Brenna Lasting Guard for 2 rounds. Lasting Guard reduces the next hit she takes by 18% and records the prevented damage as Memory.

activeSkill.name: Stand Again
activeSkill.description: Deals 180% of Attack damage to all enemies and gives all allies Lasting Guard for 2 rounds. Each ally can record up to 8% of their Max HP as Memory. When Lasting Guard expires, its holder heals for their recorded Memory amount.

passive1.name: Deep Resolve
passive1.description: Brenna gains 10% Max HP, 8% Defense, and 8% Block. The first time each round an ally’s Lasting Guard prevents damage, Brenna copies 40% of its recorded Memory. At the start of her next turn, she may spend all copied Memory to give the lowest-HP ally a Shield of that value.

passive2.name: Survival of the Stubborn
passive2.description: The first time an ally would be defeated while holding Lasting Guard, consume that Guard, leave them at 1 HP, and give Brenna the prevented hit as copied Memory. This triggers once per battle.

talentI.name: Memory of Every Blow
talentI.description: Lasting Guard records up to 12% Max HP instead of 8%.

talentII.name: Shared Wall
talentII.description: When Brenna spends copied Memory, the Shield also grants 10% Damage Reduction for 1 round.

talentIII.name: What Held Once
talentIII.description: After Survival of the Stubborn triggers, Brenna’s next Stand Again immediately gives each ally 4% Max HP as recorded Memory.

heroes.name: Edrin
heroes.title: The Distant Bell
heroes.lore: Edrin spent most of his life guarding a remote settlement that was slowly being abandoned. Rather than leave with everyone else, he remained behind, maintaining the old watchtowers and keeping the roads safe for those who still returned. He believed that something did not need to be thriving to deserve protection. If even one part remained alive, it was worth preserving.

basicAttack.name: Mark of Survival
basicAttack.description: Deals 120% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP and applies Observed Mark for 2 rounds. When an enemy with Observed Mark is attacked by Edrin again, the Mark grows by 1 stage, up to 3 stages.

activeSkill.name: The Old Watchtower
activeSkill.description: Deals 220% of Attack damage to all enemies. The enemy with the highest Observed Mark stage is additionally struck for 100% of Attack damage and has its Observed Mark converted into a Watcher's Ledger. For 2 rounds, whenever the Ledger's target takes damage, the Ledger records 25% of that damage. When the Ledger expires, it deals damage equal to the stored amount to its target and heals Edrin for 50% of the stored amount.

passive1.name: Guardian of What Remains
passive1.description: Edrin gains 8% Attack, 8% Speed, and 8% Crit Chance. Whenever Edrin attacks an enemy with Observed Mark, he gains 1 Record, up to 4. Each Record increases his damage against marked enemies by 4%.

passive2.name: Still Here
passive2.description: When an ally falls below 35% HP, Edrin immediately attacks the enemy with the highest Observed Mark stage for 80% of Attack damage and grants the lowest-HP ally a Shield equal to 6% of Edrin's Max HP for 2 rounds. This can trigger once per round. If the attacked enemy has 3 Observed Mark stages, Edrin gains 10 Energy.

talentI.name: Kept Watch
talentI.description: Observed Mark lasts 1 additional round. When a Observed Mark reaches 3 stages, Edrin immediately heals for 4% of his Max HP.

talentII.name: Watchfires
talentII.description: When The Old Watchtower creates a Watcher's Ledger, the Ledger also grants the lowest-HP ally a Shield equal to 5% of Edrin's Max HP for 2 rounds.

talentIII.name: Nothing Is Lost
talentIII.description: When a Watcher's Ledger expires, 50% of its stored damage is retained as Record instead of being lost. The next time Edrin reaches 4 Record, consume all Record to deal the retained damage to the enemy with the lowest HP.

heroes.name: Elyra
heroes.title: The Patient Warden
heroes.lore: Elyra was a keeper of an ancient sanctuary where wounded soldiers from opposing armies were allowed to recover without question. When violence repeatedly followed them inside, she changed the sanctuary rather than abandoning it, teaching its guardians to restrain those who could not yet put down their weapons. She came to believe that survival sometimes requires stopping movement long enough for something to heal.

basicAttack.name: Patient Measure
basicAttack.description: Deals 115% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack and applies Slow for 2 rounds. If the target is already affected by Slow, Elyra heals the lowest-HP ally for 55% of Attack.

activeSkill.name: Sanctuary Unbroken
activeSkill.description: Deals 190% of Attack damage to all enemies and applies Slow for 2 rounds. The enemy with the highest Attack is additionally affected by Taunt for 1 round. While Taunted, that enemy cannot choose another target for attacks. When Taunt ends, deal 80% of Attack damage to that enemy and heal the lowest-HP ally for 100% of Attack.

passive1.name: Slow Growth
passive1.description: Elyra gains 8% Attack, 10% Effect Hit, and 8% Skill Damage. Whenever an enemy affected by Slow takes damage from Elyra, she gains 1 Patience, up to 4. Each Patience increases the healing of Elyra's abilities by 5%.

passive2.name: Stillness Pays
passive2.description: Whenever Taunt from Sanctuary Unbroken ends, Elyra consumes all Patience and deals an additional 30% of Attack damage per Patience to the Taunted enemy. For each 2 Patience consumed, Elyra also heals the lowest-HP ally for 40% of Attack. If 4 Patience are consumed, Elyra gains 15 Energy.

talentI.name: Deep Rest
talentI.description: Slow applied by Elyra lasts 1 additional round. When an enemy's Slow expires naturally, Elyra gains 5 Energy.

talentII.name: Sanctuary Spreads
talentII.description: When Sanctuary Unbroken applies Taunt, the enemy with the lowest HP also receives Slow for 2 rounds and takes 50% of Attack damage.

talentIII.name: Calculated Patience
talentIII.description: When Stillness Pays consumes 4 Patience, the Taunted enemy receives an additional 100% of Attack damage and the lowest-HP ally gains a Shield equal to 8% of Elyra's Max HP for 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Isara
heroes.title: The Second Chance
heroes.lore: Isara was a physician who refused to abandon patients simply because their first recovery had failed. She became known for keeping dying villages alive through years of famine, rebuilding what could be saved after every collapse. She came to believe that survival was not measured by never falling, but by what remained capable of growing afterward.

basicAttack.name: Restoring Touch
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% of Attack damage to the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally for 55% of Attack. If that ally is below 35% HP, the healing is increased by 50%.

activeSkill.name: Return After Loss
activeSkill.description: Deals 165% of Attack damage to all enemies and heals all allies for 95% of Attack. The two lowest-HP allies gain a Seedling for 2 rounds. When a Seedling bearer would fall below 20% HP, consume the Seedling to restore 12% of their Max HP and grant a Shield equal to 8% of Isara's Max HP for 2 rounds. Each Seedling can trigger once.

passive1.name: Persistent Life
passive1.description: Isara gains 10% Max HP, 10% Effect Resist, and 8% Defense. Whenever Isara heals an ally below 50% HP, she gains 1 Growth, up to 3. At 3 Growth, her next Basic Attack consumes all Growth and heals the lowest-HP ally for an additional 90% of Attack.

passive2.name: What Survives
passive2.description: Whenever a Seedling triggers, Isara gains 10 Energy and heals the lowest-HP ally for 60% of Attack. If the Seedling bearer survives an attack that would have reduced them below 20% HP without triggering, their Seedling remains and its next healing effect is increased by 50%.

talentI.name: Deeper Resolve
talentI.description: Seedlings last 1 additional round. When a Seedling triggers, the Shield granted to its bearer is increased by 50%.

talentII.name: Shared Recovery
talentII.description: When a Seedling triggers, the ally with the lowest HP other than the triggering ally is healed for 70% of Attack.

talentIII.name: Second Chance
talentIII.description: The first Seedling to trigger each battle also prevents its bearer from receiving lethal damage from that attack, leaving them at 1 HP before its healing and Shield are applied.

heroes.name: Sylven
heroes.title: The Unfading Blade
heroes.lore: Sylven documents wounds because every injury reveals which protections failed. He believes what survives an ending should carry the consequence forward.

basicAttack.name: Open Wound
basicAttack.description: Deals 120% of Attack damage and applies Bleed for 2 rounds. Bleed deals 35% of Attack damage at the end of each round and records the target’s last positive effect before it takes damage.

activeSkill.name: Collect the Wound
activeSkill.description: Deals 215% of Attack damage to an enemy with Bleed and consumes its Bleed. Create a Scar Record for 3 rounds containing the Bleed’s remaining damage and the target’s last positive effect before it was damaged. When Scar Record expires, it deals the stored damage to its target.

passive1.name: Persistent Edge
passive1.description: Sylven gains 10% Attack, 8% Speed, and 8% Crit Chance. When a Bleeding enemy is defeated, transfer its Scar Record or Bleed to the highest-HP enemy for 2 rounds. Transferred Bleed deals 20% more damage but cannot be extended.

passive2.name: Wounds Remember
passive2.description: When an enemy with Scar Record gains a positive effect matching the recorded effect, remove both effects and deal 100% of Attack damage. If no effect was recorded, the first positive effect it gains is treated as the record instead.

talentI.name: Lasting Evidence
talentI.description: Scar Record lasts 1 additional round and may store 120% of Attack damage.

talentII.name: Inherited Injury
talentII.description: When Bleed transfers after a defeat, the new target loses 10 Energy.

talentIII.name: Nothing Heals Cleanly
talentIII.description: When Wounds Remember removes a matching effect, the target receives 20% Healing Reduction for 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Corin
heroes.title: The Patience Engineer
heroes.lore: Corin rebuilt a collapsed aqueduct one span at a time while everyone urged him to abandon it.

basicAttack.name: Measurement Strike
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Settling for 2 rounds. Settling reduces Speed by 8% each round, up to 24%.

activeSkill.name: Weight of Time
activeSkill.description: Deals 180% Attack damage to enemies with Settling. Targets at 24% Speed Down are Stunned for 1 round.

passive1.name: Load Bearing
passive1.description: When Settling expires, apply 15% Defense Down for 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Halwen
heroes.title: The Reserve Keeper
heroes.lore: Halwen kept a famine store closed until the relief caravan arrived. Survival means preserving enough for tomorrow.

basicAttack.name: Reserve Swing
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and grants Reserve for 2 rounds. Reserve reduces the next damage taken by 18%.

activeSkill.name: Open the Reserve
activeSkill.description: Deals 165% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Reserve to all allies for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Rationed Strength
passive1.description: When Reserve prevents damage, its holder recovers 4% Max HP, or gains 6 Energy at full HP.

heroes.name: Jory
heroes.title: The Old Gate
heroes.lore: Jory retired from arena fighting only after becoming its gatekeeper. Endurance matters when it protects someone behind you.

basicAttack.name: Holdfast Thrust
basicAttack.description: Deals 115% Attack damage. If Jory was attacked since his last turn, he heals 4% Max HP.

activeSkill.name: Bar the Way
activeSkill.description: Deals 185% Attack damage and Taunts the front enemy for 2 rounds; it deals 15% less damage to Jory.

passive1.name: Worn Hinges
passive1.description: If the same enemy hits Jory twice in a round, he counterattacks it for 70% Attack damage.

heroes.name: Maera
heroes.title: The Harbor Eye
heroes.lore: Maera guarded a lighthouse through a blockade because every returning boat deserved one familiar signal.

basicAttack.name: Returning Shot
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage; if the target attacked an ally since Maera’s last turn, deals 25% additional Attack damage.

activeSkill.name: Keep the Beacon
activeSkill.description: Deals 215% Attack damage to the enemy that most recently damaged an ally. On defeat, allies recover 7% Max HP.

passive1.name: Watch the Water
passive1.description: The first time each ally falls below 45% HP, Maera’s next attack is guaranteed Critical and she cannot be controlled.

heroes.name: Maren
heroes.title: The Long Sleeper
heroes.lore: Maren tended soldiers in suspended sleep until their war ended. Recovery can be slow, but it must be allowed to finish.

basicAttack.name: Waking Touch
basicAttack.description: Deals 100% Attack damage and heals the lowest-HP ally for 45% Attack.

activeSkill.name: Unfinished Rest
activeSkill.description: Deals 150% Attack damage to all enemies and gives the two lowest-HP allies Recovery for 3 rounds. Recovery heals 3% Max HP each turn.

passive1.name: Do Not Disturb
passive1.description: When an ally with Recovery would die, remove Recovery and leave them at 1 HP; this triggers once per battle.

heroes.name: Brio
heroes.title: The Patient Record
heroes.lore: Brio recorded the names of a ruined village for twenty years until compensation was finally paid. He refuses to let survivors become footnotes.

basicAttack.name: Recorded Shot
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and applies Accounted for 2 rounds. Attacks against Accounted cannot miss.

activeSkill.name: Evidence Kept
activeSkill.description: Deals 205% Attack damage to an Accounted enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally for 6% Max HP.

passive1.name: Nothing Forgotten
passive1.description: When an Accounted enemy is defeated, Brio gives Accounted to the highest-HP enemy for 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Elin
heroes.title: The Second Stitch
heroes.lore: Elin was a battlefield tailor who kept repairing uniforms until their owners came home. Persistence is work, not a promise.

basicAttack.name: Mending Prick
basicAttack.description: Deals 100% Attack damage and heals the lowest-HP ally for 50% Attack.

activeSkill.name: Hold the Seam
activeSkill.description: Deals 150% Attack damage to all enemies and gives an ally with lowest HP Stitching for 3 rounds. Stitching heals 3% Max HP at turn end.

passive1.name: Tighten the Thread
passive1.description: When Stitching expires naturally, its holder gains 10 Energy.

heroes.name: Marn
heroes.title: The Holding Wall
heroes.lore: Marn built a refuge around a displaced community, making food and cover available from the same secure store. He protects what still has time to recover.

basicAttack.name: Garrison Guard
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and gives the lowest-HP ally Coverguard for 2 rounds. Coverguard reduces the next hit by 14%.

activeSkill.name: Reserve Shelter
activeSkill.description: Deals 165% Attack damage to all enemies and gives every ally Coverguard for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Relief After Loss
passive1.description: When Coverguard is consumed, its holder heals 3% Max HP.

heroes.name: Rusk
heroes.title: The Patchmaker
heroes.lore: Rusk made patched water pumps keep working decades beyond their warranty. He sees survival in every repair that holds one more day.

basicAttack.name: Patch Round
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and gives a random ally Patchwork for 2 rounds. Patchwork grants 8% Defense.

activeSkill.name: Keep It Running
activeSkill.description: Deals 175% Attack damage to all enemies and refreshes the duration of every Patchwork effect.

passive1.name: Borrowed Time
passive1.description: When Patchwork prevents an ally from falling below 1 HP, remove it and leave that ally at 1 HP, once per battle.

heroes.name: Garron
heroes.title: The Stout Frame
heroes.lore: Garron kept a refuge supplied through a long siege by building sturdy frames from wreckage. Survival needs something to hold onto.

basicAttack.name: Frame Strike
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and gives Garron 6% Block for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Set Iron
passive1.description: When Garron blocks an attack, he heals 3% Max HP.

heroes.name: Nara
heroes.title: The Road Nurse
heroes.lore: Nara treated people on the road after her clinic was destroyed. She believes care survives because people carry it onward.

basicAttack.name: Roadside Care
basicAttack.description: Deals 100% Attack damage and heals the lowest-HP ally for 45% Attack.

passive1.name: Carry On
passive1.description: The first time an ally is healed below 35% HP, they gain 6% Damage Reduction for 1 round.

heroes.name: Wynn
heroes.title: The Hand-Me-Down
heroes.lore: Wynn repaired discarded tools and placed them where strangers would need them. What endures should be passed forward.

basicAttack.name: Mended Shot
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and grants a random ally 5% Defense for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Useful Again
passive1.description: When an ally with Wynn’s Defense buff is hit, Wynn gains 5 Energy.

heroes.name: Hal
heroes.title: The Stone Cache
heroes.lore: Hal planted supply caches in broken walls after a siege. He trusts what keeps growing where it was not expected.

basicAttack.name: Cache Shovel
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and recovers 2% Max HP.

heroes.name: Iri
heroes.title: The Kept Token
heroes.lore: Iri carried a pocket of ration tokens through a famine because someone had to believe in next season.

basicAttack.name: Tokenkeeper’s Tap
basicAttack.description: Deals 100% Attack damage and heals the lowest-HP ally for 30% Attack.

heroes.name: Aeron
heroes.title: The Unbroken Stride
heroes.lore: Aeron learned that a formation breaks when even one promised action arrives late. He believes momentum is not stolen by speed, but by making others repay the time they assumed was theirs.

basicAttack.name: Press Forward
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% of Attack damage and delays the target by 12% turn progress. Apply Turn Debt equal to the progress removed, up to 30%, for 2 rounds.

activeSkill.name: Break the Rhythm
activeSkill.description: Deals 185% of Attack damage to all enemies and delays the enemy with the highest Energy by 25% turn progress. That enemy receives 25% Turn Debt. When an enemy with Turn Debt begins its turn, it loses 5 Energy for every 10% Turn Debt and Turn Debt is removed.

passive1.name: Never Yield the Pace
passive1.description: Aeron gains 8% Speed and 8% Block. When an enemy repays Turn Debt, Aeron records the Energy lost. At the start of his next turn, his Basic Attack deals additional damage equal to 15% of the recorded Energy as a percentage of Attack, up to 75%.

passive2.name: Momentum Breaker
passive2.description: If an enemy with Turn Debt gains enough Energy to use an active skill before it begins its turn, consume Turn Debt, delay it by 10% turn progress, and give the lowest-Energy ally the Energy it would have lost. This can trigger once per enemy each battle.

talentI.name: Interest Owed
talentI.description: Turn Debt lasts 1 additional round. Enemies that end a turn with unspent Turn Debt lose 5% Speed for 1 round.

talentII.name: Shared Tempo
talentII.description: When Momentum Breaker gives Energy to an ally, that ally also advances by 10% turn progress.

talentIII.name: Unpaid Action
talentIII.description: The first enemy each round to repay at least 20% Turn Debt is Silenced for 1 round after its turn ends.

heroes.name: Dahlia
heroes.title: The Wayward Hymn
heroes.lore: Dahlia was a traveling cantor who settled disputes by making people listen before they could answer. When a violent uprising threatened to consume her city, she kept its people moving through the streets in carefully timed waves, preventing the factions from ever meeting where they intended. She came to believe that conflict becomes dangerous when it is allowed to settle into certainty.

basicAttack.name: Offbeat Chime
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Energy and reduces that enemy's Energy by 10. If the target has more Energy than Dahlia, the lowest-HP ally is healed for 45% of Attack.

activeSkill.name: Scattered Choir
activeSkill.description: Deals 165% of Attack damage to all enemies and creates a Displaced state on the enemy with the highest Energy for 2 rounds. Displaced enemies cannot target the same ally twice in a row. Whenever a Displaced enemy attacks an ally, that ally gains 10 Energy and Dahlia heals them for 70% of Attack. If the Displaced enemy uses an Active Skill while Displaced, cancel the skill and remove Displaced.

passive1.name: Keep Them Moving
passive1.description: Dahlia gains 8% Speed and 8% Effect Hit. Whenever an enemy loses Energy because of Dahlia, she gains 1 Tempo, up to 3. At 3 Tempo, her next Basic Attack consumes all Tempo and also heals the lowest-HP ally for 80% of Attack.

passive2.name: Broken Rhythm
passive2.description: The first time each round that a Displaced enemy changes its attack target, Dahlia gains 10 Energy and the targeted ally gains a Shield equal to 6% of Dahlia's Max HP for 2 rounds. If the Displaced enemy attempts to use an Active Skill before its Displaced state expires, Dahlia immediately deals 75% of Attack damage to it and heals the lowest-HP ally for 90% of Attack.

talentI.name: Restless Chorus
talentI.description: Displaced lasts 1 additional round. The first time a Displaced enemy changes its attack target each round, that enemy also loses 10 Energy.

talentII.name: Shared Rhythm
talentII.description: Whenever Dahlia heals an ally through Broken Rhythm, the ally with the second-lowest HP is also healed for 40% of Attack.

talentIII.name: Final Cadence
talentIII.description: When Displaced ends without the enemy having its Active Skill canceled, Dahlia deals 120% of Attack damage to that enemy and immediately restores 20 Energy to the ally with the lowest Energy.

heroes.name: Merek
heroes.title: The Sequence Thief
heroes.lore: Merek exposed a military command system by making each order arrive too late to matter. He believes no sequence deserves obedience merely because it was written first.

basicAttack.name: Interjecting Clause
basicAttack.description: Deals 115% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Energy and applies Anticipated for 2 rounds. When an Anticipated enemy uses an active skill, it is delayed by 10% turn progress after the skill resolves.

activeSkill.name: Stolen Interval
activeSkill.description: Deals 190% of Attack damage to all enemies. Swap the turn progress of the enemy closest to acting with the enemy furthest from acting. The enemy moved backward gains 15% Skill Damage Down for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Unsettled Timing
passive1.description: Merek gains 8% Attack, 10% Effect Hit, and 8% Skill Damage. The first time each round an enemy loses turn progress, Merek records the amount lost. His next Basic Attack deals additional damage equal to 35% of the recorded amount as a percentage of Attack, up to 70%.

passive2.name: Priority Inversion
passive2.description: At the start of each round, designate the fastest living enemy as First Claim for 1 round. The first time First Claim uses an active skill, Merek immediately advances the lowest-Energy ally by 20% turn progress.

talentI.name: Borrowed Minute
talentI.description: When Anticipated delays an enemy, Merek gains 5 Energy and that enemy is delayed by a further 8% turn progress.

talentII.name: Reordered Agenda
talentII.description: Stolen Interval also gives the enemy moved forward 10% Defense Down for 2 rounds.

talentIII.name: No First Move
talentIII.description: When First Claim is defeated before acting, all enemies lose 12 Energy and Merek immediately takes a Basic Attack.

heroes.name: Oris
heroes.title: The Unwritten Path
heroes.lore: Oris was a wandering bard who refused to perform the same song twice. He built a strange mechanical flute whose shifting keys allowed him to improvise melodies no audience could predict. After watching rulers, armies, and traditions become trapped by repeating the same mistakes, Oris came to believe that nothing should be held in place; every moment should leave room for another possibility.

basicAttack.name: Unfinished Note
basicAttack.description: Deals 125% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Speed. If the target has more Speed than Oris, Oris deals an additional 45% of Attack damage and removes 10 Energy from the target.

activeSkill.name: Improvise the Way
activeSkill.description: Deals 210% of Attack damage to all enemies and disrupts their rhythm for 2 rounds. While disrupted, the first enemy each round that would gain Energy instead loses 20 Energy and has its next action delayed by 15% turn progress. Oris then advances the next ally's turn by 15% turn progress.

passive1.name: Restless Hands
passive1.description: Oris gains 8% Speed, 6% Effect Hit, and 6% Skill Damage. Whenever an enemy's action is delayed by Oris, Oris immediately changes his next Basic Attack target to the enemy with the lowest current Energy.

passive2.name: No Fixed Refrain
passive2.description: After Oris uses his Active Skill, his next two attacks use a different firing sequence. The first attack deals 150% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Energy and removes 20 Energy; the second deals 150% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest Energy and advances Oris's turn by 10% turn progress. This sequence ends after both attacks occur or after 2 rounds.

talentI.name: Quicker Fingering
talentI.description: The altered attacks from No Fixed Refrain deal 20% additional damage. The second altered attack advances Oris's turn by an additional 5% turn progress.

talentII.name: Change the Key
talentII.description: When Oris's Active Skill disrupts an enemy that has more than 70 Energy, that enemy also loses an additional 15 Energy. When it disrupts an enemy below 30 Energy, Oris instead gains 10 Energy.

talentIII.name: Open Ending
talentIII.description: After No Fixed Refrain completes, Oris immediately uses an additional 90% Attack damage attack against the enemy the second altered attack struck. This can occur once every 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Zella
heroes.title: The Slow Argument
heroes.lore: Zella was a poisoner who learned that panic made people reveal more than confession. She sees every reaction as proof that a fixed response can be made to betray itself.

basicAttack.name: Quiet Dose
basicAttack.description: Deals 120% of Attack damage and applies Residue for 3 rounds. At the start of the target’s turn, Residue deals 30% of Attack damage and records whether it used a Basic Attack or active skill.

activeSkill.name: Counterargument
activeSkill.description: Deals 210% of Attack damage to an enemy with Residue. If it has used the same action type on each of its last two turns, consume Residue to deal an additional 120% of Attack damage and Silence it for 1 round.

passive1.name: Reaction Study
passive1.description: Zella gains 10% Attack and 12% Effect Hit. When a Residue target changes its action type, it loses 10 Energy and Residue is extended by 1 round, once per target each battle.

passive2.name: Nothing Stays Settled
passive2.description: When a Residue target is defeated, transfer its Residue and recorded action history to the highest-HP enemy for 2 rounds. Transferred Residue cannot be extended.

talentI.name: Measured Reply
talentI.description: Residue also reduces the target’s Effect Resist by 10% while it has repeated an action type.

talentII.name: Forced Conclusion
talentII.description: Counterargument applies Silence for 2 rounds if it consumes Residue from an enemy with two repeated actions.

talentIII.name: Changing Testimony
talentIII.description: When a Residue target changes action type, Zella gains a guaranteed Critical Hit on her next attack.

heroes.name: Eira
heroes.title: The Rolling Barricade
heroes.lore: Eira moved barricades nightly during a siege. Protection becomes a prison when it cannot change shape.

basicAttack.name: Shove Aside
basicAttack.description: Deals 100% Attack damage and moves the target to the back if another enemy is alive.

activeSkill.name: Redeploy Cover
activeSkill.description: Deals 155% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Mobile Cover for 2 rounds; it reduces the first area hit each round by 20%.

passive1.name: Leave No Corner
passive1.description: When an ally with Mobile Cover is singled out, advance its turn progress by 12%.

heroes.name: Finn
heroes.title: The Bellmaker
heroes.lore: Finn made bells ring at the wrong hour to keep occupiers sleepless. Interruption can be kinder than obedience.

basicAttack.name: Ringing Slug
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Ringing for 2 rounds. Ringing loses 5 Energy when using an active skill.

activeSkill.name: No Quiet Moment
activeSkill.description: Deals 175% Attack damage to enemies with Ringing and interrupts a charging active skill; interrupted enemies lose 20 Energy.

passive1.name: Aftershock Clock
passive1.description: At round end, Ringing enemies have a 35% chance to be delayed by 15% turn progress.

heroes.name: Niko
heroes.title: The Uninvited Guest
heroes.lore: Niko crashed councils that decided other people’s futures. Disruption is the entrance fee for an excluded voice.

basicAttack.name: Bad Entrance
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and applies Flustered for 2 rounds, reducing Effect Hit by 15%.

activeSkill.name: Take the Floor
activeSkill.description: Deals 205% Attack damage to a Flustered enemy and forces its next Basic Attack onto a random ally.

passive1.name: Ruin the Agenda
passive1.description: When a Flustered enemy attempts a debuff, replace Flustered with Silence for 1 round. Silence prevents active skills.

heroes.name: Sable
heroes.title: The Queue Cutter
heroes.lore: Sable organized a city strike by changing meeting points nightly. Any order that cannot be interrupted is a prison.

basicAttack.name: Cut In
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and advances Sable’s next turn by 10%.

activeSkill.name: Wrong Order
activeSkill.description: Deals 190% Attack damage to all enemies and delays the highest-Energy enemy by 25% turn progress.

passive1.name: Never Waiting
passive1.description: Whenever an enemy is delayed, Sable gains 12 Energy and her next Basic Attack gains 30% Attack damage.

heroes.name: Tamsin
heroes.title: The Loose Thread
heroes.lore: Tamsin unpicked a dictator’s ceremonial robes during his coronation. One small flaw can make imposed order unravel.

basicAttack.name: Snag
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and removes 6% turn progress for each target buff, up to 18%.

activeSkill.name: Pull the Seam
activeSkill.description: Deals 185% Attack damage to all enemies. Targets above 50% turn progress are delayed 20% and take 15% more Skill Damage for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Unraveling Order
passive1.description: The first enemy delayed each round gains 10% Defense Down for 2 rounds.

heroes.name: Avera
heroes.title: The Interrupter
heroes.lore: Avera learned music in secret after a governor banned public gatherings. Her notes always arrive before the expected silence.

basicAttack.name: Offbeat Note
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Disrupted for 2 rounds. Disrupted targets lose 8 Energy after an active skill.

activeSkill.name: Break the Measure
activeSkill.description: Deals 185% Attack damage to all Disrupted enemies and has a 50% chance to delay each by 15% turn progress.

passive1.name: Encore Denied
passive1.description: The first enemy delayed each round takes 10% more damage until its next turn.

heroes.name: Lydia
heroes.title: The Unscheduled
heroes.lore: Lydia kept a city’s food trains moving by ignoring the official timetable. A schedule deserves disruption when it abandons people.

basicAttack.name: Platform Change
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and advances Lydia’s next turn by 8%.

activeSkill.name: Miss the Train
activeSkill.description: Deals 180% Attack damage to all enemies and delays the slowest enemy by 30% turn progress.

passive1.name: No Fixed Departure
passive1.description: Whenever Lydia acts before the slowest enemy, she gains 10% Damage Reduction until her next turn.

heroes.name: Roan
heroes.title: The Side Door
heroes.lore: Roan mapped the unnoticed service passages through a palace. He believes every closed system has an exit someone forgot to guard.

basicAttack.name: Unexpected Entry
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and applies Off Balance for 2 rounds. Off Balance lowers Effect Resist by 15%.

activeSkill.name: Through the Service Door
activeSkill.description: Deals 200% Attack damage to an Off Balance enemy and removes one buff from it.

passive1.name: Leave Before Asked
passive1.description: After Roan defeats an Off Balance enemy, he becomes Untargetable until his next turn.

heroes.name: Tomas
heroes.title: The Door Jammer
heroes.lore: Tomas wedged doors open during a factory fire when every foreman ordered them shut. He distrusts anything designed to hold people still.

basicAttack.name: Prybar
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and reduces the target’s turn progress by 10%.

activeSkill.name: Force the Exit
activeSkill.description: Deals 165% Attack damage to the front enemy and Taunts it for 1 round; it loses 15% Speed for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Keep Moving
passive1.description: When Tomas is hit by a slowed enemy, he gains a 10% Max HP Shield for 1 round.

heroes.name: Jax
heroes.title: The Clockwork Rat
heroes.lore: Jax built noisy toys to disrupt secret meetings in occupied alleys. A disturbance can create the space to escape.

basicAttack.name: Rattle Shot
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and reduces the target’s turn progress by 8%.

passive1.name: Loose Spring
passive1.description: When Jax delays an enemy, he gains 5% Speed for 1 round.

heroes.name: Kora
heroes.title: The Interrupted Queue
heroes.lore: Kora walked out of every line that made people wait for permission to live. Momentum begins with stepping aside.

basicAttack.name: Skip Ahead
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and advances Kora’s next turn by 10%.

passive1.name: First Opening
passive1.description: Kora deals 10% more damage to enemies that have not acted this round.

heroes.name: Sena
heroes.title: The Empty Chair
heroes.lore: Sena moved chairs before every forbidden reading, so no raid found the same room twice. Nothing important should stay predictable.

basicAttack.name: Displaced Arrow
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and applies 8% Speed Down for 1 round.

passive1.name: Unfixed Aim
passive1.description: Sena gains 10% Critical Chance against slowed enemies.

heroes.name: Bex
heroes.title: The Unlatched
heroes.lore: Bex opened a locked factory gate during a strike and never again trusted a rule just because it was closed.

basicAttack.name: Latchbreaker
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and gains 5% Speed for 1 round.

heroes.name: Till
heroes.title: The Shifting Target
heroes.lore: Till moved his repair cart every night to avoid patrols. He believes staying still is an invitation.

basicAttack.name: Rolling Shot
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and reduces the target’s turn progress by 5%.

heroes.name: Cyrra
heroes.title: The Burden Bearer
heroes.lore: Cyrra spent her life tending the final moments of people who had been forgotten. She learned that pain does not always need to be erased; sometimes it can be contained, hidden, and turned into something that keeps another person alive.

basicAttack.name: Hidden Burden
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% of Attack damage to the front enemy and applies Burden for 2 rounds. Burden deals 35% of Cyrra’s Attack damage at the end of each round. If the target is already Burdened, Cyrra instead removes 1 round of Burden and heals the lowest-HP ally for 70% of Attack.

activeSkill.name: Bury the Burden
activeSkill.description: Deals 160% of Attack damage to all enemies and applies Burden for 2 rounds. Cyrra then removes Burden from the enemy with the highest remaining Burden damage. The removed damage is converted into healing equal to 100% of that amount, divided between the two lowest-HP allies. If the removed damage exceeds 8% of Cyrra’s Max HP, those allies also gain a Shield equal to 6% of Cyrra’s Max HP for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Silent Weight
passive1.description: Cyrra gains 10% Effect Resist and 8% Max HP. Whenever Cyrra removes Burden from an enemy, she gains 1 Veiled Weight, up to 3. Each Veiled Weight increases her healing by 5%.

passive2.name: Carry the Burden
passive2.description: Whenever an ally below 40% HP is healed by Cyrra, she may consume 1 Veiled Weight to also remove 1 round of Burden from the enemy with the highest Attack. When this happens, that ally receives healing equal to 80% of Attack and Cyrra gains 5 Energy. This can trigger once per round.

talentI.name: Deeper Silence
talentI.description: Bury the Burden removes Burden from the enemy with the highest remaining Burden damage a second time. The second removal converts only 60% of its removed damage into healing.

talentII.name: Hidden Reserve
talentII.description: When Bury the Burden creates a Shield, 50% of healing that exceeded an ally’s Max HP is stored. When that Shield breaks, the ally is healed for the stored amount.

talentIII.name: Final Weight
talentIII.description: When Cyrra reaches 3 Veiled Weight, her next Bury the Burden consumes all Veiled Weight. The removed Burden damage is increased by 50% before being converted into healing, but Cyrra cannot gain Veiled Weight during that cast.

heroes.name: Darian
heroes.title: The Hidden Bulwark
heroes.lore: Darian served as the shield-bearer of a ruler whose victories were built around a single principle: never let the enemy know where the real danger was. He learned to protect people without drawing attention to himself, absorbing blows that were meant for others and disappearing from the enemy's calculations until the decisive moment. He came to believe that the strongest protection is the one the enemy never realizes exists.

basicAttack.name: Hidden Counter
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% of Attack damage to the front enemy. If Darian currently has a Shield, he stores 1 Veil Charge, up to 3. At 3 Veil Charges, his next Basic Attack consumes all Charges and deals an additional 90% of Attack damage.

activeSkill.name: Bastion of Secrecy
activeSkill.description: Deals 175% of Attack damage to all enemies and grants Darian and the lowest-HP ally a Shield equal to 12% of Darian's Max HP for 2 rounds. Each time either Shield absorbs damage, Darian stores 20% of that absorbed damage as Hidden Strength, up to 15% of his Max HP. When either Shield expires or breaks, consume Hidden Strength to deal that amount as damage to the enemy with the highest Attack and heal Darian for 50% of the damage dealt. If both Shields survive until they expire, Darian gains 20 Energy.

passive1.name: Unseen Guard
passive1.description: Darian gains 10% Max HP and 8% Defense. Whenever an ally below 50% HP receives a Shield from Darian, that ally gains 1 Veil Charge. At 2 Veil Charges, the ally's next incoming hit deals 20% less damage and consumes all of their Veil Charges.

passive2.name: The Cost of Knowing
passive2.description: Whenever Hidden Strength reaches 10% of Darian's Max HP, Darian gains 10 Energy and the enemy with the highest Attack takes 50% of Attack damage. When Hidden Strength reaches its maximum, the next damage dealt by Darian consumes all Hidden Strength and deals an additional 75% of Attack damage.

talentI.name: Deeper Secrecy
talentI.description: Bastion of Secrecy's Shields last 1 additional round. Hidden Strength can store up to 20% of Darian's Max HP instead of 15%.

talentII.name: Shared Burden
talentII.description: When an ally's Shield from Bastion of Secrecy breaks, 50% of the remaining Hidden Strength is converted into a new Shield on that ally lasting 1 round.

talentIII.name: False Opening
talentIII.description: When both Shields from Bastion of Secrecy expire without breaking, Darian immediately gains 2 Veil Charges and his next attack consumes them to deal an additional 120% of Attack damage.

heroes.name: Mireth
heroes.title: The Erased Name
heroes.lore: Mireth was an archivist who discovered that the most dangerous people in history were not always those with the greatest armies, but those whose names could never be forgotten. She began removing records of tyrants, conspirators, and warlords until their influence slowly disappeared with their recognition. To Mireth, power begins with being remembered—and sometimes the most effective victory is making something impossible to find.

basicAttack.name: Unwritten Line
basicAttack.description: Deals 115% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack. If the target has a positive status, Mireth applies Focus to it for 2 rounds and gains 5 Energy.

activeSkill.name: Remove From Record
activeSkill.description: Deals 200% of Attack damage to all enemies. The enemy with the highest Attack becomes Focused for 2 rounds. While Focused, the first time that enemy receives a positive status, that status is removed immediately and Mireth deals an additional 70% of Attack damage to the enemy. This can trigger once per round.

passive1.name: Absence Has Weight
passive1.description: Mireth gains 8% Attack, 10% Effect Hit, and 8% Skill Damage. Whenever a Focused enemy loses a positive status, Mireth gains 1 Absence, up to 3. Each Absence increases Mireth's damage against Focused enemies by 6%.

passive2.name: The Missing Page
passive2.description: When a Focused enemy has a positive status removed by Remove From Record, Mireth stores 1 Page, up to 3. When Mireth reaches 3 Pages, consume all Pages to deal 120% of Attack damage to the Focused enemy and apply AttackDown for 2 rounds. If the target already has AttackDown, instead deal 70% of Attack damage to all other enemies.

talentI.name: Deeper Erasure
talentI.description: Remove From Record can trigger twice per Focused enemy during its duration, but the second trigger deals 30% less bonus damage.

talentII.name: Blank Space
talentII.description: When The Missing Page consumes 3 Pages, Mireth also gains 15 Energy and the Focused enemy loses 10 Energy.

talentIII.name: No Record Remains
talentIII.description: When The Missing Page triggers against an enemy below 30% HP, its additional damage increases by 80% of Attack and the target loses its remaining Focus duration. This can trigger once per battle.

heroes.name: Nysera
heroes.title: The Missing Arrow
heroes.lore: Nysera was a royal hunter who became famous for eliminating threats without anyone realizing she had been there. She learned that the most valuable shot was not always the one that killed, but the one that made an enemy forget where danger had come from. She embraced Umbra after abandoning the courts, believing that the greatest advantage was being impossible to account for.

basicAttack.name: Unseen Shot
basicAttack.description: Deals 120% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack and applies Vanishing Mark for 2 rounds. The next time that enemy targets Nysera, Vanishing Mark is removed and Nysera becomes Untargetable for 1 round.

activeSkill.name: Where I Was Not
activeSkill.description: Deals 215% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack and 125% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP. The two targets become Linked for 2 rounds. When either Linked enemy targets Nysera, the attack is redirected to the other Linked enemy and deals 80% of the original damage instead. The Link ends after triggering once.

passive1.name: Absence
passive1.description: Nysera gains 8% Speed, 8% Crit Chance, and 8% Effect Hit. Whenever Vanishing Mark triggers, she gains 1 Absence, up to 3. Each Absence increases her damage by 5%.

passive2.name: Unaccounted For
passive2.description: Whenever Nysera becomes Untargetable, she prepares a Hidden Arrow. Her next attack while no enemy can directly target her deals an additional 70% of Attack damage. After firing the Hidden Arrow, Nysera gains 10 Energy. This can trigger once per round.

talentI.name: Deeper Absence
talentI.description: Vanishing Mark lasts 1 additional round. When it triggers, Nysera also removes 1 positive status from its target.
