talentII.name: False Target
talentII.description: When the Linked effect redirects an attack away from Nysera, the redirected damage is increased by 25% of Attack and the enemy that was originally targeted loses 10 Energy.

talentIII.name: Last Known Position
talentIII.description: When Nysera becomes Untargetable through Vanishing Mark, her next attack ignores 15% of the target's Defense. If that attack defeats the target, Nysera immediately becomes Untargetable again for 1 round.

heroes.name: Velis
heroes.title: The Hollow Vow
heroes.lore: Velis was an executioner who discovered that killing a wounded enemy was often easier than preventing them from recovering. He abandoned the executioner's court and began hunting battlefield physicians instead, believing that victory belonged to whoever could decide when recovery was no longer possible. His faith in Umbra came from the belief that some things should not be allowed to return once they have been taken away.

basicAttack.name: Denied Return
basicAttack.description: Deals 130% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP. If the target is below 40% HP, Velis gains 8 Energy and the attack deals an additional 45% of Attack damage.

activeSkill.name: Hollow the Wound
activeSkill.description: Deals 245% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP. If the target is below 50% HP, it becomes Hollowed for 2 rounds. The next time a Hollowed enemy receives healing, that healing is converted into 60% of the healing amount as damage to the enemy instead. Hollowed can trigger once before it expires.

passive1.name: No Second Breath
passive1.description: Velis gains 8% Attack, 8% Speed, and 8% Effect Hit. Whenever an enemy below 50% HP receives healing, Velis gains 10 Energy. If that enemy is Hollowed, Velis instead gains 15 Energy.

passive2.name: What Was Taken
passive2.description: Whenever Hollowed converts healing into damage, Velis stores 1 Remnant, up to 3. At 3 Remnants, Velis consumes them to immediately attack the enemy with the lowest HP for 120% of Attack damage. If that enemy is below 30% HP, the attack deals an additional 80% of Attack damage.

talentI.name: Deeper Wound
talentI.description: Hollowed lasts 1 additional round. Its healing conversion increases from 60% to 75%, but it can still trigger only once per application.

talentII.name: Starve the Light
talentII.description: When Hollowed converts healing into damage, the target also loses 10 Energy. If this reduces the target to 0 Energy, Velis gains 10 additional Energy.

talentIII.name: Final Denial
talentIII.description: When What Was Taken consumes 3 Remnants against an enemy below 30% HP, the attack also prevents that enemy from receiving healing until the end of its next turn. This is a unique combat rule and requires engine support for healing prevention.

heroes.name: Iolan
heroes.title: The Redacted Judge
heroes.lore: Iolan struck names from public records so a regime could not find the families attached to them.

basicAttack.name: Strike the Line
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and removes one target buff; if none is removed, applies 10% Effect Hit Down for 2 rounds.

activeSkill.name: Record Withheld
activeSkill.description: Deals 175% Attack damage to all enemies and applies Unlisted for 1 round. Unlisted enemies cannot gain Energy from passives.

passive1.name: Missing Precedent
passive1.description: When an Unlisted enemy uses an active skill, remove one random positive buff after it resolves.

heroes.name: Ruma
heroes.title: The False Trail
heroes.lore: Ruma built decoy wagons for people fleeing a purge. Her inventions make attention choose the wrong target.

basicAttack.name: Decoy Round
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies False Lead for 2 rounds. The next single-target skill at Ruma targets a random enemy ally.

activeSkill.name: Everyone Looks Here
activeSkill.description: Deals 180% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Ruma Concealed for 1 round. Concealed units cannot be targeted directly.

passive1.name: Spare Route
passive1.description: When False Lead redirects a skill, the redirected target takes 20% less damage and Ruma gains 15 Energy.

heroes.name: Toren
heroes.title: The Closed Door
heroes.lore: Toren hid a village behind a sealed mountain pass and never told its pursuers where it was.

basicAttack.name: Lockstep
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Sealed for 2 rounds. Sealed targets cannot receive new buffs.

activeSkill.name: No Entry
activeSkill.description: Deals 175% Attack damage and Taunts the front enemy for 2 rounds. While Taunted it is Sealed.

passive1.name: Unasked Question
passive1.description: When a Sealed enemy targets another ally, Toren gains a 10% Max HP Shield and redirects 25% of that hit.

heroes.name: Petra
heroes.title: The Unsent Letter
heroes.lore: Petra destroyed letters that would have exposed a resistance network. Silence, to him, is an active form of shelter.

basicAttack.name: Returned Mail
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and applies Withheld for 2 rounds. Withheld targets cannot gain new buffs.

activeSkill.name: Keep the Secret
activeSkill.description: Deals 170% Attack damage to the front enemy and Taunts it for 1 round; it is also Withheld.

passive1.name: Private Address
passive1.description: When a Withheld enemy targets an ally, Petra gains 8% Damage Reduction for 1 round.

heroes.name: Altheon
heroes.title: The First Witness
heroes.lore: Altheon was a magistrate who believed every action should leave a trace. During a siege, he discovered that careful records could preserve evidence after every witness had gone. He learned to fix moments in place so what happened could never simply be undone.

basicAttack.name: Witness Script
basicAttack.description: Deals 120% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack. Damage increases by 35% if Altheon has already damaged that enemy this round.

activeSkill.name: Immaculate Record
activeSkill.description: Deals 185% of Attack damage to all enemies and marks the enemy with the highest Attack as the Subject for 2 rounds. The first time the Subject takes damage from Altheon each round, record 30% of that damage. When Subject expires, deal damage equal to all recorded damage to the Subject. If recorded damage reaches 120% of Altheon’s Attack, the Subject instead takes an additional 80% of Attack damage.

passive1.name: Preserved Moment
passive1.description: Altheon gains 8% Attack, 8% Speed, and 8% Skill Damage. Whenever he damages the same enemy more than once in a round, he gains 1 Record, up to 3. Each Record increases his damage against that enemy by 5%.

passive2.name: Fixed in Place
passive2.description: Whenever Subject receives delayed damage from Immaculate Record, Altheon gains 10 Energy and records the Subject’s current HP. If the Subject’s HP increases above the recorded value before Subject expires, Altheon’s next attack against that enemy deals an additional 75% of Attack damage.

talentI.name: Deeper Record
talentI.description: Immaculate Record records 40% of damage instead of 30%. The maximum recorded damage remains unchanged.

talentII.name: Secondary Record
talentII.description: When Subject expires, Altheon also deals damage equal to 50% of the recorded damage to the enemy with the lowest HP.

talentIII.name: Final Record
talentIII.description: When Subject reaches the maximum recorded damage, consume all Record stacks on that Subject. Each stack increases the final damage by 20% of Attack. This can trigger once per battle.

heroes.name: Aminah
heroes.title: The True Measure
heroes.lore: Aminah served as a physician in a city where healers were expected to treat everyone equally, regardless of rank. She became frustrated by how often the most visible wounds received attention while quieter suffering went unnoticed. She began marking every patient according to what they truly needed rather than what they appeared to need. Her belief in Lumen was simple: healing should be precise, deliberate, and never wasted.

basicAttack.name: Marked Diagnosis
basicAttack.description: Deals 105% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Attack and applies Diagnosis for 2 rounds. The lowest-HP ally is healed for 55% of Attack. If the diagnosed enemy is below 50% HP, the healing is increased by 40%.

activeSkill.name: Restore the Balance
activeSkill.description: Deals 155% of Attack damage to all enemies and marks the ally with the lowest HP as Priority for 2 rounds. While Priority is active, the first time that ally would receive healing, 50% of that healing is stored instead of restored immediately. When Priority ends, the stored healing is released at once. If the ally falls below 30% HP while Priority is active, immediately release the stored healing and remove Priority.

passive1.name: Precise Care
passive1.description: Aminah gains 8% Max HP and 8% Speed. Whenever she heals an ally below 40% HP, she gains 1 Measure, up to 3. Each Measure increases her healing by 5%.

passive2.name: No Wasted Recovery
passive2.description: Whenever Priority releases stored healing, Aminah records the amount restored. Her next Basic Attack deals additional damage equal to 50% of the recorded healing, up to 120% of Attack. If the recorded healing was released because the ally fell below 30% HP, the additional damage is instead dealt to the enemy with the highest Attack.

talentI.name: Defined Priority
talentI.description: Priority can remain active for 1 additional round. The stored healing is increased by 20%, but it can still trigger only once.

talentII.name: Shared Measure
talentII.description: When Priority releases stored healing, 35% of the released amount is also restored to the ally with the second-lowest HP.

talentIII.name: Perfect Timing
talentIII.description: If Priority releases because its bearer falls below 30% HP, consume all Measure. For each Measure consumed, restore an additional 4% of the target's Max HP and remove 1 negative status from that ally.

heroes.name: Arden
heroes.title: The Precise Measure
heroes.lore: Arden was a surveyor who spent years measuring borders that armies had fought over for generations. He learned that the smallest overlooked detail could determine where an entire conflict ended. In battle, he applies the same principle: find the exact point where an enemy is vulnerable, define it, and never waste an arrow anywhere else.

basicAttack.name: Find the Measure
basicAttack.description: Deals 125% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest HP and applies Measured for 2 rounds. When Arden attacks a Measured enemy, he deals additional damage equal to 2% of the target's Max HP, capped at 100% of Attack.

activeSkill.name: Define the Weak Point
activeSkill.description: Deals 190% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest HP and applies True Measure for 2 rounds. The first 3 times Arden damages a True Measure target, each hit deals additional damage equal to 3% of the target's Max HP, capped at 120% of Attack per hit. After the third hit, True Measure is removed and Arden gains 15 Energy.

passive1.name: Exact Calculation
passive1.description: Arden gains 8% Speed and 5% Armor Break. His damage against Measured enemies increases by 8%. If a Measured enemy is above 70% HP, Arden's attacks against it deal an additional 1% of its Max HP as damage, capped at 50% of Attack.

passive2.name: Everything Has a Limit
passive2.description: Whenever Arden triggers the bonus damage from True Measure, he records 20% of the target's current HP. When True Measure is removed, if the target's current HP is higher than the lowest recorded value, Arden immediately deals damage equal to the difference, capped at 150% of Attack.

talentI.name: Deeper Measure
talentI.description: Measured lasts 1 additional round and its Max HP damage increases to 2.5%, capped at 110% of Attack.

talentII.name: Perfect Line
talentII.description: The first time each round Arden attacks a True Measure target, the attack ignores 10% of the target's Defense. If the target is above 70% HP, Arden also gains 5 Energy.

talentIII.name: Final Calculation
talentIII.description: When True Measure is removed after its third trigger, consume all recorded values from Everything Has a Limit. The target takes additional damage equal to 50% of the highest recorded value, capped at 180% of Attack. This can trigger once per battle.

heroes.name: Caldus
heroes.title: The Appointed Guard
heroes.lore: Caldus was a sworn guardian who believed protection became meaningless when its boundaries were unclear. He spent years defending people who were overlooked by armies and courts, eventually developing a simple doctrine: choose what must be protected, choose what must be confronted, and never allow either decision to become uncertain. He embraced Lumen because he believed every conflict becomes manageable once its purpose is clearly defined.

basicAttack.name: Answer the Blade
basicAttack.description: Deals 115% of Attack damage to the front enemy. If that enemy is currently Focused by Caldus, Caldus gains 5 Energy.

activeSkill.name: Declare the Threat
activeSkill.description: Deals 180% of Attack damage to all enemies and applies Focus to the enemy with the highest Attack for 2 rounds. While Focused, that enemy is treated as Caldus's Declared Target. Whenever the Declared Target attacks Caldus, Caldus immediately counterattacks for 75% of Attack damage. Each enemy can trigger this counterattack only once per round. If the Declared Target attacks another ally instead, Caldus deals 45% of Attack damage to that enemy and gains 8 Energy.

passive1.name: Defined Duty
passive1.description: Caldus gains 8% Max HP and 8% Defense. Whenever Caldus counterattacks his Declared Target, he gains 1 Resolve, up to 3. Each Resolve increases his next counterattack damage by 10%, then removes 1 Resolve.

passive2.name: No Uncertain Ground
passive2.description: When the Declared Target attacks another ally instead of Caldus, that ally receives a Shield equal to 5% of Caldus's Max HP for 2 rounds. If the Shield is broken by the Declared Target, Caldus immediately counterattacks for 90% of Attack damage. This can trigger once per round.

talentI.name: Absolute Focus
talentI.description: Declare the Threat applies Focus for 1 additional round. Caldus's counterattacks against the Declared Target deal 20% more damage, but the Declared Target can trigger his primary counterattack only once every 2 rounds.

talentII.name: Guardian's Oath
talentII.description: When the Declared Target attacks another ally, the Shield granted by No Uncertain Ground is increased to 8% of Caldus's Max HP. When that Shield breaks, Caldus heals for 5% of his Max HP.

talentIII.name: Final Verdict
talentIII.description: When the Declared Target falls below 30% HP, Caldus immediately gains 2 Resolve and his next counterattack deals an additional 100% of Attack damage. This can trigger once per battle.

heroes.name: Isolde
heroes.title: The Slow Fading
heroes.lore: Isolde was once a royal investigator who learned that the most reliable way to expose a conspiracy was not to strike at its center, but to quietly remove everything supporting it. She became an assassin who preferred wounds that revealed themselves only after the fight had already begun. To her, Lumen meant making every hidden consequence impossible to ignore.

basicAttack.name: Exposed Vein
basicAttack.description: Deals 125% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP and applies Lingering Proof for 2 rounds. Lingering Proof deals 35% of Attack damage at the end of each round. If the target already has Lingering Proof, its remaining duration is refreshed instead.

activeSkill.name: Inevitable Decay
activeSkill.description: Deals 220% of Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP and applies Revelation for 3 rounds. Whenever a Revealed enemy takes damage over time, record 25% of that damage. When Revelation expires, deal damage equal to the recorded amount to the target. If the target is defeated before Revelation expires, transfer the recorded damage to the enemy with the lowest HP.

passive1.name: Proof Leaves a Trace
passive1.description: Isolde gains 8% Speed, 8% Effect Hit, and 8% Holy Damage. Whenever damage over time from Isolde deals damage, she gains 1 Trace, up to 4. Each Trace increases her damage over time by 5%.

passive2.name: Unfinished Sentence
passive2.description: The first time each round that a Revealed enemy takes damage over time, Isolde immediately deals 55% of Attack damage to that enemy. If the enemy has three or more active damage-over-time effects, this damage instead deals 90% of Attack damage and Isolde gains 8 Energy.

talentI.name: Deeper Trace
talentI.description: Lingering Proof deals 15% more damage. When Lingering Proof expires naturally, Isolde gains 10 Energy.

talentII.name: Revealed Consequence
talentII.description: When Revelation expires, 35% of its recorded damage is also dealt to the enemy with the lowest HP. If Revelation transfers to a new target because its original target was defeated, the new target also receives Lingering Proof for 2 rounds.

talentIII.name: Final Revelation
talentIII.description: When Revelation expires with 4 Traces, consume all Traces to immediately trigger 60% of its remaining recorded damage. If the target is below 25% HP, the trigger instead deals 100% of the recorded damage.

heroes.name: Leon
heroes.title: The Numbered Arrow
heroes.lore: Leon catalogued every missing person after a civil war, then hunted captors who assumed the dead would stay uncounted.

basicAttack.name: Catalogue Shot
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and assigns Case Number for 2 rounds, revealing current HP, Energy, and buffs to allies.

activeSkill.name: Close the Case
activeSkill.description: Deals 225% Attack damage to an enemy with Case Number. Damage increases 10% per displayed buff, up to 40%.

passive1.name: No Unfiled Death
passive1.description: When a Case Number target dies, allies gain 8 Energy and the highest-Attack enemy receives Case Number.

heroes.name: Lio
heroes.title: The Clear Diagnosis
heroes.lore: Lio refused to treat patients with comforting lies. Healing begins only when a wound is named precisely.

basicAttack.name: Tested Touch
basicAttack.description: Deals 100% Attack damage and removes one debuff from the lowest-HP ally.

activeSkill.name: Name the Wound
activeSkill.description: Deals 150% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Diagnosed for 2 rounds. Diagnosed allies receive 18% more healing.

passive1.name: Exact Treatment
passive1.description: When Lio removes a debuff, that ally recovers 5% missing HP; control debuffs also grant 10 Energy.

heroes.name: Nadine
heroes.title: The Border Clerk
heroes.lore: Nadine documented crossings in a city that denied some people existed. No one should be erased by an unmarked boundary.

basicAttack.name: Stamp of Entry
basicAttack.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and applies Registered for 2 rounds. Registered targets cannot become Concealed or Untargetable.

activeSkill.name: Hold the Line
activeSkill.description: Deals 190% Attack damage and marks the target position for 2 rounds. It cannot move and takes 12% more damage from Nadine.

passive1.name: Proper Place
passive1.description: When a Registered enemy attempts to move or hide, Nadine counterattacks it for 80% Attack damage and removes that effect.

heroes.name: Clara
heroes.title: The Named Remedy
heroes.lore: Clara catalogued ailments in a city whose physicians dismissed the poor as nameless cases. Precise recognition is her first cure.

basicAttack.name: Case Note
basicAttack.description: Deals 100% Attack damage and removes one debuff from the lowest-HP ally.

activeSkill.name: Prescribe Exactly
activeSkill.description: Deals 150% Attack damage to all enemies and gives all allies Clarified for 2 rounds. Clarified allies gain 12% Effect Resist.

passive1.name: Known Condition
passive1.description: When Clara removes a control debuff, the ally gains 12 Energy.
